ops_incidents.summary: Production checkout-api POST /v1/checkout returning 503 on 5 consecutive checks over 5 minutes; customer-facing checkout likely down.
ops_incidents.fix_note: 1. Check the checkout service health and recent deploys or restarts in the 01:00-01:12 UTC window. 2. Inspect the upstream or gateway logs for the 503 source and any dependency errors. 3. Escalate to the owning team and confirm checkout recovers on the next uptime check.

ops_incidents.summary: onboarding-flow fails in staging CI smoke test at Code: map contact with TypeError reading 'email' of undefined.
ops_incidents.fix_note: 1. Inspect the input items to Code: map contact in the failed staging execution. 2. Guard the access with optional chaining or a null check, or fix the upstream field path. 3. Rerun the ci-smoke test to confirm it passes.

ops_incidents.summary: orders-db production Postgres primary failed with 'No space left on device' during a file extend; order data writes are at risk.
ops_incidents.fix_note: 1. Check disk usage on the Postgres primary host and identify what filled the volume, including WAL and logs. 2. Free space safely, such as archiving old WAL or logs, or expand the volume, and confirm the primary accepts writes. 3. Verify orders writes and n8n retries succeeded, then review for any lost or unprocessed orders.

ops_incidents.summary: Nightly order sync failed: upstream orders backend returned 503 (reported as down) at Fetch upstream orders. Job will not self-recover.
ops_incidents.fix_note: 1. Confirm the orders backend status with its owner and check whether it has recovered. 2. Once healthy, re-run the Nightly order sync execution or wait for the next scheduled run. 3. Consider enabling retry on the Fetch upstream orders node to handle short outages.
